summary: Electra Battery Materials filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 15, 2026 press release disclosing Nasdaq's grant of an additional 180-calendar-day extension, through March 15, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. Nasdaq's determination relies on the company meeting market value of publicly held shares and all other Capital Market initial listing standards, plus Electra's written intent to cure via a reverse stock split if necessary. Compliance returns after a $1.00 closing bid for at least 10 consecutive business days, subject to Nasdaq discretion. TSX-V listing is unaffected. Watch for a reverse-split announcement and continued sub-$1 trading.
